message.content:
In the absence of any community cards, the only information we have is each player’s two‑card “hole” hand.  
If we rank those hands as if they were the only cards available (i.e., we compare the best possible 5‑card hand that could be made from just those two cards), the order is:

| Player | Hole Cards | Rank |
|--------|------------|------|
| **Alex** | A♠ K♠ | Highest (Ace‑King suited) |
| Robert | Q♥ 10♥ | Second best |
| Steve | 5♠ 4♠ | Third |
| Sam | 3♦ 2♣ | Lowest |

So, **Alex** would win the hand.
